year_layers.narrative: Designated Senior Lead, Software Development, in July, and anchored the first modules of the next-generation platform in October. Triaged the release that put Vermont's change function live on its public deadline and stood by through the go-live weekend, brought portal pages under about three seconds and was named TExeter Thought Leader. Exeter closed in November after its acquisition; I declined the acquirer's offer and spent four months choosing my next company.

company.took: Exeter made me an owner. On state health insurance exchanges the deadline was public and the evidence had to hold, so I learned to find the root cause before touching the code and to propose a phased clean up instead of a rewrite. Starting TExeter taught me that a community can change how a whole company learns, if someone starts it and keeps showing up. Transformation is not about erasing the past but evolving it with purpose, and I still work that way.
